cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Start the Hard Part
cards.instruction: Get someone else to explain, announce, or begin the emotionally difficult part.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. You tell the choir the tour's cancelled. I'll hand out the refund forms.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Exactly. The forms will need my full attention.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Say 'funding' first. I'll join after the disappointed silence.
